claims.statement: For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z with success 0.39 (claimed floor; measured at production ratio 0.4761 with Clopper-Pearson 95% lower bound 0.4713 at n=30000, model 0.4791), and its complete classical work is at most 2^126.2508 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation. The step is the SQUARED STEP y'=(y*TBL[t][kappa])^2, which is a function of the Frobenius class alone (no prev_row, no ring, no history), so a class repeat is a state repeat and the cycle abort is sound. FAMILY-FREE BY THEOREM, NOT BY DEBIT: class merging forces m(k)=sigma^(-k)(A_t), and sigma^6 is inversion on the order-r subgroup (p^6=-1 mod r), so m(k+6)=m(k)^-1 in all 384 measured columns; the inverse-pair family is an identity of the sigma-orbit structure and cannot be partitioned away. Squaring is the minimal sound fix: the two-step return y^3=sigma^j/(m1^4 m2^2) has exactly one solution per multiplier pair. Proof: evidence/impossibility-theorem.md, with a planted table mutation that makes the column scan flag exactly the mutated column. PRICE, MEASURED: one extra Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring per multiply step, counted on the shipped object (510194 mul steps and 510194 cyclo_sqr calls in one run, instrumented re-run reproducing the plain run's success vector element for element), so mul_step 21889 -> 33521 (+11632), c_stress 0.964032 -> 1.346817, delta +0.4824 bits measured against the +0.473 estimate. LEDGER, ONE SUM, EVERY ROW DISPLAYED: S*c_stress (2^126.250778) + trap charge (2^11.497, per-trail birthday abandon at the cap horizon t=128*theta, rate 2^-78.27 at N=(r-1)/12=2^251.2721) + 8 enumerated aux rows (2^56.510, charged AT the report cap) + a Chernoff-derived overflow bound (1 ref op); total 2^126.250778, claim 126.2508 = least 4-decimal log2 >= the exact Fraction total plus 2e-5 bits, asserted in Fraction and in the log domain. The v24 aux RESERVE IS DELETED (it was un-displayed padding) and the whole aux block sits 70 bits below the step term, so aux completeness cannot move the 4th decimal. RANK LOSS DISCLOSED, NEVER HIDDEN: 126.2508 is 0.4308 bits behind the live board minimum 125.82 and 0.4128 behind this account's valid 125.838.

title: Squared-step class-merge rho for fixed-G1 pairing inversion, with an impossibility proof for the inverse-pair table family
